serverInfo.name: rock-gym-pro-mcp
serverInfo.title: Rock Gym Pro MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for Rock Gym Pro, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many customers are checked in at our gym right now?"; "List the members whose membership has expired in the last 30 days."; "Which bookings do we have for the Saturday climbing class?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rock Gym Pro data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rockgympro_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rockgympro_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rockgympro_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rockgympro_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rockgympro_list_facilities
tools.title: List facilities
tools.description: List the facilities the connected API key can read, with their 3-letter codes. Start here to find a facilityCode for the other tools. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/facilities.

tools.name: rockgympro_get_connection_info
tools.title: Get API connection info
tools.description: Show the token information for the connected API key. Use it to check that the key works. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/me.

tools.name: rockgympro_get_setting
tools.title: Get a setting
tools.description: Get one setting value by name (the settings table), optionally for several facilities. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/settings.

tools.name: rockgympro_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the customers of a facility, filtered by type, status, dates, name, email or address. Text filters accept % wildcards. Page through results with page and limit. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/customers/facility/{facilityCode}.

facilityCode.description: Facility code (3 capital letters). Defaults to the connected facility.

waiverSigned.description: Only customers whose waiver is signed (true) or not (false).

ageGreaterThan.description: Age in years, at least this many.

ageLessThan.description: Age in years, at most this many.

emailAllowMarketing.description: Only customers who allow email marketing (true) or not (false).

firstContactDateStarting.description: First contact on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

firstContactDateEnding.description: First contact on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

lastVisitDateStarting.description: Last visit on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

lastVisitDateEnding.description: Last visit on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

lastEditDateStarting.description: Last edit on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

lastEditDateEnding.description: Last edit on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: rockgympro_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer's details by customer GUID. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/customers/{customerGuid}.

tools.name: rockgympro_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List the bookings of a facility, optionally for one customer or a date-time range. Page with startId, page and limit. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/bookings/facility/{facilityCode}.

facilityCode.description: Facility code (3 capital letters). Defaults to the connected facility.

customerGuid.description: Only records for this customer GUID.

startDateTime.description: Bookings starting on or after this time, yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

endDateTime.description: Bookings starting on or before this time, yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

tools.name: rockgympro_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Get one booking's details by its ID. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/bookings/facility/{facilityCode}/{bookingId}.

facilityCode.description: Facility code (3 capital letters). Defaults to the connected facility.

tools.name: rockgympro_list_checkins
tools.title: List check-ins
tools.description: List the check-ins of a facility, optionally for one customer or a date-time range. Page with startId, page and limit. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/checkins/facility/{facilityCode}.

facilityCode.description: Facility code (3 capital letters). Defaults to the connected facility.

customerGuid.description: Only records for this customer GUID.

customerDetails.description: Include the customer details in each check-in.

startDateTime.description: Check-ins on or after this time, yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

endDateTime.description: Check-ins on or before this time, yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

tools.name: rockgympro_get_checkin
tools.title: Get a check-in
tools.description: Get one check-in by its ID. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/checkins/facility/{facilityCode}/{checkinId}.

facilityCode.description: Facility code (3 capital letters). Defaults to the connected facility.

tools.name: rockgympro_get_active_checkin_count
tools.title: Count active check-ins
tools.description: Get how many customers are checked in right now at a facility. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/checkins/active/facility/{facilityCode}.

facilityCode.description: Facility code (3 capital letters). Defaults to the connected facility.

tools.name: rockgympro_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of a facility, optionally for one customer or a date-time range. Void invoices are included unless includeVoidInvoices is 0. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/invoices/facility/{facilityCode}.

facilityCode.description: Facility code (3 capital letters). Defaults to the connected facility.

customerGuid.description: Only records for this customer GUID.

startDateTime.description: Invoices on or after this time, yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

endDateTime.description: Invoices on or before this time, yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

includeVoidInvoices.description: 1 includes void invoices (default), 0 leaves them out.

facilityCode.description: Facility code (3 capital letters). Defaults to the connected facility.
